items.statement: At least 60 percent of eligible young people offered peer support take it up, at least 75 percent of those remain in contact at six months, and recovery questionnaires are completed by at least 65 percent, meeting progression criteria for a definitive trial.
items.rationale: Thresholds follow the benchmarks from the retrieved feasibility trial (c2) adjusted for a single service.

items.statement: Uptake is lower among young men, daily cannabis users and young people without stable housing.
items.rationale: These groups disengage most (c4); the study can describe but not test differences.

summary: Two hypotheses; h1 selected as the progression question.
